title: Child's crown on a baby tooth
also: stainless steel crown for a child
what: The dentist puts a ready-made children's crown on a baby tooth. It protects a badly damaged tooth until it falls out.
why: When a baby tooth is badly damaged, or after nerve treatment, and a filling might not hold.
tell_doctor: Your child's allergies, including to metals
How your child copes with dental treatment
If your child grinds their teeth

prepare.title: Mood
prepare.text: Tell your child that the doctor will put a little "hat" on the tooth to make it strong.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Feed your child 1 to 2 hours before the visit.

steps: The tooth is cleaned and shaped a little
A crown of the right size is chosen
The crown is fixed with special cement
The doctor checks how the teeth meet
feel: Pressure when the crown is put on
Numbness for 1 to 2 hours, if an injection was given
In the first days the crown may feel strange
after: Do not feed your child until the numbness is gone
Brush the tooth with the crown like other teeth
Limit sticky sweets - toffee and chewing gum
The crown usually falls out together with the baby tooth
red_flags: The crown fell out or is loose
Swollen gum around the crown, or pain

faq.q: Is the crown taken off later?
faq.a: Usually not - it falls out together with the baby tooth when the time comes.

faq.q: Is it harmful for the permanent tooth?
faq.a: No. The crown is only on the baby tooth.

reminders.text: Your child is getting a tooth crown tomorrow. Feed your child 1 to 2 hours before the visit.
